info.title: Dastyare Social — CS
info.description: REST API for Dastyare Social — Creator Studio. Manage posts (threads, shorts, media) and stories. Supports JSON and multipart uploads, reactions, views, and likes. Authentication via Your API key. See /llms.txt for LLM-oriented documentation. NOTE: SEO & LLM discovery (sitemaps, llms.txt, structured data, MCP) is experimental — whether search engines or AI assistants discover, cite, or surface this content can't be fully relied on.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file

width.description: Media width in px — read on the client before upload

height.description: Media height in px — read on the client before upload

duration.description: Video duration in ms — read on the client before upload

url.description: Public URL of the uploaded media

filename.description: Original file name, used for the extension

mimeType.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. video/mp4 or image/jpeg

uploadUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL — valid for 1 hour

post.description: Single-file upload endpoint (multipart/form-data with a `file` field). Server-side upload — buffers the file then uploads to S3. Returns media metadata. For real upload progress, use `/api/upload/presign` + `/api/upload/confirm` (direct browser-to-S3) instead.

requestBody.description: Multipart form data containing a file upload.

post.description: Step 2 of the direct upload flow: after the browser PUTs the file to the presigned URL, call this with the `key` plus client-side metadata. Returns the public URL and full media object ready for post/story creation.

Returns a presigned URL the browser can PUT to directly, giving real upload progress via xhr.upload.progress. Step 1 of the direct upload flow: call this, PUT the file to `uploadUrl`, then call `/api/upload/confirm` with the returned `key`.

get.description: Returns paginated posts with reactions. Use query type=count for total count, type=shorts for vertical videos (1080x1920). Default type=list.

post.summary: Create Post — Upload Media Via URL
post.description: Create a post from a JSON body. Media must be referenced by URL — upload files to `/api/upload` (server-side) or `/api/upload/presign` + `/api/upload/confirm` (direct browser-to-S3) first, then map the returned `url`, `kind` (as `type`), `width`, `height`, and `duration` into the `media` array below. JSON body with action=batch-view and ids array increments views for multiple posts.

get.description: Returns paginated stories. Use query type=count for total. Filter by kind=image or kind=video.

post.summary: Create Story — Upload Media Via URL
post.description: Create a story from a JSON body. Media must be referenced by URL — upload files to `/api/upload` (server-side) or `/api/upload/presign` + `/api/upload/confirm` (direct browser-to-S3) first, then map the returned `url`, `kind` (as `type`), `width`, `height`, and `duration` into the `media` field below. Types: image, video. An array of media items creates one story per item.
Perform actions on a story. action=view increments views. action=like with direction=inc or dec toggles likes.

patch.description: Partial update of story fields (type, views, likes, media).

delete.description: Permanently deletes a story by ID.
